## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the problem it solves.

## Validation

State which checks you ran and their results.

- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] `pnpm check`
- [ ] `pnpm build`

## Local-first and deterministic review

- [ ] This change does not add telemetry, cloud authentication, or third-party scan APIs.
- [ ] This change does not add exploitation behavior, credential attacks, or broad port-range scanning.
- [ ] Any new check module has fixed documented rules, plain-English remediation, and unit tests.
- [ ] Scoring and README documentation were updated if the grading behavior changed.

## Screenshots or notes

Include relevant screenshots or implementation notes. Remove targets, IP addresses, credentials, scan reports, and other sensitive information before sharing.
